postgresql_integration_dependency.description: This hardening lane is scheduled to run immediately after the completion of the comprehensive PostgreSQL database integration.

modules.title: Module 1: State Isolation & UI Integration
modules.description: Fix frontend-backend state conflicts by isolating the analytics state in the desktop cockpit UI, converting list-based widget payloads into camelCase key-value mappings, and wiring subscription actions.
objectives: Separate analytics state from the main desktop projection by storing it under state.analytics in the frontend.
Convert the backend's list-based widgets payload to a camelCase key-value mapping expected by frontend widgets.
Wire the analytics_subscribe WebSocket action in the UI mode-selector to establish a reliable server subscription.

proposed_changes.description: Prevent analytics projections from overwriting the main state.projection by routing them to state.analytics.
Update widget render methods to consume the camelCase widget mapping instead of a flat list.
Send an analytics_subscribe WebSocket event when the user switches to the analytics dashboard view.

automated_tests: pytest tests/desktop/test_websocket_server.py to ensure the server processes analytics_subscribe requests.
Add front-end integration tests to verify state.analytics update sequences.
manual_verification: Launch Desktop Cockpit in analytics mode and check console log for successful analytics_subscribe message.
Verify widgets render without causing other panels to go blank.

modules.title: Module 2: Multi-Provider Routing & Interactive Drilldowns
modules.description: Establish dynamic analytical query routing between the PostgreSQL remote server and the local DuckDB memory fallback, and implement drilldown layouts in the UI.
objectives: Build a multi-provider router in the analytics engine to route queries to PostgreSQL when available, falling back to local DuckDB.
Implement interactive drilldown events from compact chip and standard card states to expanded full-page layouts.
Maintain content-light security guarantees by enforcing SHA256 hashing on all queries routed to remote providers.

proposed_changes.description: Introduce a routing layer capable of coordinating queries across PostgreSQL and memory-only DuckDB.
Allow drilldown state indicators to trigger WebSocket updates requesting specific database records.
Implement clickable components on cards that transition the view to high-disclosure tables.

automated_tests: pytest tests/analytics/test_analytics_engine.py to verify routing logic and fallback mechanisms.
Test hashing rules on test queries to ensure no raw prompts are leaked.
manual_verification: Manually disconnect the remote PostgreSQL database and check that the app falls back to local DuckDB.
Click on the 'Governance Gate' standard card to verify that it expands to the detailed table view.

modules.title: Module 3: Ingestion Resilience & Telemetry Schema Normalization
modules.description: Ensure robust importing of telemetry data into the analytics lake through transaction-wrapped atomic ingestion and normalized schema structures.
objectives: Wrap all telemetry file ingestion sequences in database transactions to prevent partial updates and data pollution on error.
Normalize telemetry payload formats into standard relational views for unified analytical compilation.
Enforce strict schema validation rules using Pydantic models prior to analytical indexing.

proposed_changes.description: Enclose ingestion loops in transaction blocks and roll back on ingestion errors.
Refactor SQL templates to map and join normalized telemetry columns consistently.
Add strict validation rules to telemetry collection objects prior to serializing.

automated_tests: pytest tests/analytics/test_analytics_engine.py to verify that transactions roll back on malformed lines.
Validate schemas on generated ingestion models using jsonschema.
manual_verification: Inject a corrupt JSON line into observability.jsonl and run ingestion to confirm no records are imported.
Confirm that standard queries succeed once log corruption is fixed.
